(4) At the date and time of porting fixed by the Mobile Number Portability Service provider, the Mobile Number Portability Service provider shall communicate to the Donor Operator its instructions for disconnection of the mobile number and the Donor Operator shall, immediately and in any case within 4[two hours] of receipt of such instructions,— (a) comply with such instructions; and (b) report compliance of such instructions to the Mobile Number Portability Service provider.
